title: ClearFront: add category artwork and detail-on-preview card faces
description: Operator-requested presentation improvement after decomposition. Generate three original bitmap category artworks (Unit, Spell, Relic). Compact card faces show cost/name/art/category/stats while full rules text, keywords, and conditions appear in existing hover/touch previews. No card rules, balance, or state behavior changes. Design checklist: improves clarity/readability, adds no mechanic or tracking state, and reuses one image per category to minimize complexity.
acceptance_criteria: Three original project-local bitmap assets clearly distinguish Unit, Spell, and Relic without embedded text or watermarks.
Compact card faces show card name, category artwork, cost, type, and applicable stats; detailed rules/keywords/condition information remains available in desktop hover and touch-hold previews.
Existing click/target/unavailable/status behavior and card-game rules are unchanged; seeded combat/blocking and undo regressions pass.
The presentation passes the design checklist: improves clarity, adds no mechanic or hidden tracking, and uses the smallest three-asset category system.
app remains file:// compatible with zero console errors/exceptions; source/baseline remain unchanged and focused screenshots/evidence are recorded.
